## Budgets

Each budget counts charges by the verbs that name it. Its limit is a `policy.json` value, plus one when the first try is free. When the count reaches the limit, an exhaustion verb is taken instead. Exhaustion of an infrastructure budget always leads to a human wait of the same phase. Every exhaustion that leads to a human wait names its counter in `pending_human_action.counter`, and the resume from that wait starts exactly that counter again, and no other.

| Budget | One charge | Counter | Limit | Infrastructure | Charged by | Exhaustion |
|:-------|:-----------|:--------|:------|:---------------|:-----------|:-----------|
| `task_total` | one task allocation of any kind | `budget.attempts_used`, counted per generation | `retries.max_attempts_per_contribution` (36) | no | `allocate_task_retry` from `development.agent_running`; `allocate_task_retry` from `handoff.agent_running`; `allocate_task_retry` from `planning.agent_running`; `allocate_task_retry` from `upstream_review.agent_running`; `dispatch_planning` from `planning.idle`; `request_patch` from `development.fix_needed`; `request_repair` from `development.fix_needed`; `request_review_revision` from `upstream_review.fix_needed`; `request_submission_rewrite` from `handoff.review_due`; `request_upstream_revision` from `upstream_review.fix_needed` | `exhaust_task_total`: `planning.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_task_total`: `development.fix_needed` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_task_total`: `handoff.review_due` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `handoff.agent_running` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `task_recovery` | one fresh task graph after a terminal task without a usable Result | `active_task.attempt` | 1 + `retries.task_recovery` (2) = 3 | yes | `allocate_task_retry` from `development.agent_running`; `allocate_task_retry` from `handoff.agent_running`; `allocate_task_retry` from `planning.agent_running`; `allocate_task_retry` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `exhaust_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `handoff.agent_running` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `planning_attempts` | one planning Result without a usable plan | `budget.planning_attempts` | `retries.planning_attempts` (3) | no | `reject_plan` from `planning.agent_running` | `exhaust_planning_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human` |
| `repair_attempts_cluster` | one repair or revision task allocation for one failing CI job; a task that is due without a failing CI job charges none | `budget.clusters[<job>]`, started again by `refresh_on_exhaustion`; the failing CI job is the first executed blocking job of the recorded CI evidence of the head that did not succeed, else the first job that evidence names as failing the runner-label check; the counts of other jobs are kept | `retries.patch_attempts_per_cluster` (3) | no | `request_repair` from `development.fix_needed`; `request_upstream_revision` from `upstream_review.fix_needed` | `refresh_on_exhaustion`: `development.fix_needed` to `queued.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `development.fix_needed` to `parked.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `no_progress` | one successive rejected or blocked outcome without progress | `budget.no_progress_streak`, started again by `record_publish_success`, `record_revision_publish_success`, and `refresh_on_exhaustion` | `retries.no_progress_review_after` (2) | no | `reject_patch_proposal` from `development.agent_running`; `reject_patch_proposal` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `refresh_on_exhaustion`: `development.fix_needed` to `queued.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `development.fix_needed` to `parked.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `flaky_reruns` | one rerun of the failed CI jobs on the exact head, requested by the repair worker | `budget.reruns.flaky`, counted for the head in `budget.reruns.head_sha` and started again whenever the recorded head changes | `retries.flaky_reruns` (1) | no | `request_ci_rerun` from `development.agent_running` | `reject_patch_proposal`: `development.agent_running` to `development.fix_needed` |
| `interrupted_reruns` | one rerun by the collector of CI jobs that were cancelled or lost their runner | `budget.reruns.interrupted`, counted for the head in `budget.reruns.head_sha` and started again whenever the recorded head changes and by `resume_ci` | `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) | yes | `rerun_interrupted_ci` from `development.waiting_ci`; `rerun_interrupted_ci` from `handoff.waiting_ci` | `exhaust_interrupted_reruns`: `development.waiting_ci` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_interrupted_reruns`: `handoff.waiting_ci` to `handoff.waiting_human` |
| `dispatch_recovery` | one dispatcher run that ended with the requested task absent or unclaimed | dispatcher runs created since the task was requested, or since its history was recorded or the queue's retry time (`retry_not_before`) when later; every counted run has ended | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `retry_dispatch` from `development.agent_running`; `retry_dispatch` from `handoff.agent_running`; `retry_dispatch` from `planning.agent_running`; `retry_dispatch` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `exhaust_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `handoff.agent_running` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `publish_recovery` | one failed publication of the same verified Result (the worker's own, or a publish-only retry) | `pending_publication.attempts` | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `schedule_publish_retry` from `development.agent_running`; `schedule_publish_retry` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `exhaust_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `source_reads` | one failed read of the upstream repository or base branch without a definitive answer, counted at most once per spacing slot (`retries.source_unavailable_minutes` divided by `retries.source_unavailable_reads`, counted from the first failed read) | `budget.source_unavailable`, the counted failed reads, since `budget.source_unavailable_since`, the last at `budget.source_unavailable_at`, of which `budget.source_unavailable_repository` could not read the repository itself: a tick that reads the upstream starts it again. It is exhausted by the first failed read once `retries.source_unavailable_minutes` minutes have passed since the first failed read and the count, that read included when it is counted, is reached: that read is never held back by the spacing | `retries.source_unavailable_reads` (3) | no | `record_source_unavailable` from `development.fix_needed`; `record_source_unavailable` from `handoff.review_due`; `record_source_unavailable` from `planning.idle`; `record_source_unavailable` from `provisioning.idle`; `record_source_unavailable` from `queued.idle`; `record_source_unavailable` from `upstream_review.fix_needed` | `exhaust_source_reads`: `queued.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `queued.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `planning.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `planning.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `provisioning.idle` to `provisioning.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `provisioning.idle` to `provisioning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `development.fix_needed` to `development.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `development.fix_needed` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `handoff.review_due` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `handoff.review_due` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `operation_launch` | one launch of a planned fork provisioning or development PR operation | `external_ids.launch_attempts` of the planned operation, started again by the resume that names `operation_launch` | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `launch_development_pr` from `development.agent_running`; `launch_development_pr` from `development.fix_needed`; `launch_development_pr` from `development.waiting_ci`; `start_operation` from `provisioning.idle` | `require_provisioning_intervention`: `provisioning.idle` to `provisioning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_development_pr_launches`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_development_pr_launches`: `development.waiting_ci` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_development_pr_launches`: `development.fix_needed` to `development.waiting_human` |
| `upstream_branch` | one lease write and readback of `riscv64` | the handoff operation's attempts | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `retry_upstream_branch` from `handoff.building_upstream_branch` | `exhaust_upstream_branch_retries`: `handoff.building_upstream_branch` to `handoff.waiting_human` |
| `submission_comment` | one attempt to post the submission package | the handoff operation's attempts | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `retry_submission_comment` from `handoff.preparing_submission` | `exhaust_comment_retries`: `handoff.preparing_submission` to `handoff.waiting_human` |

Two more limits are read from `policy.json`: `refresh.stale_after_days` (7) is the length of a stop after which `resume_stale` applies, and `human_sla_business_days.reminder` (3) is the interval of `record_reminder`.

## Operation table

Every remote effect is an operation with its own small table, held to the same checks. The intent is recorded before the effect, and the receipt is confirmed by discovering the actual resource. While an operation is open (`planned`, `applying`, `uncertain`) it fences its contribution: no park, no refresh, and no second writer. `/upstreaming resolve-operation` closes an open operation with a resolution evidence record, which the controller writes from the authorized command: who stated the disposition, where, why, and what the pipeline held about the operation at that moment.

An operation starts in `planned` (`record_intent`).

| State | Open | Exits | Description |
|:------|:-----|:------|:------------|
| `planned` | yes | 4 | The intent is recorded; the remote effect has not been attempted. |
| `applying` | yes | 5 | The remote call is in flight. |
| `uncertain` | yes | 5 | The effect may or may not exist; it is discovered, never repeated. |
| `confirmed` | no | 0 | The effect exists and was read back. |
| `failed` | no | 0 | The effect definitely did not succeed. |
| `not_launched` | no | 0 | A human established with evidence that the effect was never launched. |

### Operation `planned`
{: #operation-planned }

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `begin_effect` | tick | `applying` | capacity available; the contribution is not paused; the final check before the effect passes | none | - |
| `resolve_confirmed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `confirmed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition confirmed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_failed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `failed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition failed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_not_launched` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `not_launched` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition not-launched | sets `resolution` | - |

### Operation `applying`
{: #operation-applying }

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `record_response` | operation | `uncertain` | the remote call succeeded, or its response was lost or ambiguous. Even a successful response is provisional until discovery confirms the resource. | sets `external_ids` | - |
| `record_failure` | operation | `failed` | the remote call returned a definite failure | sets `external_ids` | - |
| `resolve_confirmed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `confirmed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition confirmed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_failed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `failed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition failed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_not_launched` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `not_launched` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition not-launched | sets `resolution` | - |

### Operation `uncertain`
{: #operation-uncertain }

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `confirm_by_discovery` | operation | `confirmed` | discovery finds the exact resource the operation proposed | sets `discovery` | - |
| `record_discovery` | operation | same state | discovery finds the resource absent or an unrelated one. Absence never proves that the effect did not launch, and elapsed time never closes an operation. | sets `discovery` | - |
| `resolve_confirmed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `confirmed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition confirmed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_failed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `failed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition failed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_not_launched` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `not_launched` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition not-launched | sets `resolution` | - |

### Operation `confirmed`
{: #operation-confirmed }

End state: no transition leaves it.

### Operation `failed`
{: #operation-failed }

End state: no transition leaves it.

### Operation `not_launched`
{: #operation-not_launched }

End state: no transition leaves it.
